popularity_prior.why_it_is_legitimate: sessions are sampled from the Amazon Clothing 5-core leave-last-out split, so every target is a real purchase; popularity bias in interaction data is a documented property, not a harness artifact

popularity_only_retrieval.method: take the category named in turn 1, sort that bucket by review count, stop. no NLP.

profile_signal.verdict: real but weak; wiring it into the score measurably HURT (-0.005). reported as a negative result rather than used.

difficulty_bucket.note: difficulty is a relabelling of scenario_type, not an independent property of the product: easy=buying, medium=browsing+boundary, hard=override
